inspired_by.name: haidrrrry/claude-remotion-skill
adopted_ideas: Render -> Extract Frames -> Inspect -> Fix loop

strict_music_policy: NO BACKGROUND MUSIC across ALL 9 FIKRA STUDIO modes. Only clean voiceover, justified SFX, subtle ambience, or intentional silence.

anti_slide_motion_rules.name: Video, Not Slides
anti_slide_motion_rules.rule: Scenes must flow as one continuous world with motivated camera movement (push, pan, whip, zoom-to-subject) and a persistent visual thread. Never build flat fade-between-slides.
anti_slide_motion_rules.arabic_summary: فيديو متصل وليس شرائح باوربوينت: حركة كاميرا مستمرة وربط بصري بين المشاهد بدون انتقالات باهتة متكررة.

anti_slide_motion_rules.name: Deterministic Frame Clock
anti_slide_motion_rules.rule: In Remotion, drive 100% of motion via useCurrentFrame(), spring(), and interpolate(). CSS transitions, Tailwind animate-* classes, and Math.random() are forbidden.
anti_slide_motion_rules.arabic_summary: توقيت حتمي مرتبط بالإطار: استخدام useCurrentFrame وspring فقط في Remotion ومنع Math.random أو CSS transitions.

anti_slide_motion_rules.name: Mobile Readability Floor
anti_slide_motion_rules.rule: Never render on-screen text smaller than 30px on a 1080px-wide canvas. Keep at most 2 text hierarchy levels per scene.
anti_slide_motion_rules.arabic_summary: وضوح القراءة على الجوال: لا يقل حجم الخط عن 30px في عرض 1080px مع مستويين نصيين كحد أقصى في المشهد.

anti_slide_motion_rules.name: Living Background
anti_slide_motion_rules.rule: Backgrounds must never sit static. Use subtle parallax drift, fine film grain, or motivated palette shifts tied to story beats.
anti_slide_motion_rules.arabic_summary: خلفية حية غير جامدة: حركة خفيفة أو ملمس حبيبي (Film Grain) أو تغير لوني مبرر مع تصاعد القصة.

anti_slide_motion_rules.name: Render-Inspect-Fix Loop
anti_slide_motion_rules.rule: After rendering, always extract a labeled contact sheet and run FFmpeg blackdetect + Arabic RTL check before final delivery.
anti_slide_motion_rules.arabic_summary: حلقة الفحص قبل التسليم: استخراج لقطات الشاشة وفحص الإطارات السوداء وسلامة العربية RTL قبل الاعتماد.

anti_slide_motion_rules.name: Zero Background Music
anti_slide_motion_rules.rule: Background music and music generation are strictly forbidden in all 9 modes. Pair motion beats with justified SFX, voiceover, or intentional silence.
anti_slide_motion_rules.arabic_summary: حظر الموسيقى بالكامل في الأوضاع التسعة: الاعتماد على التعليق الصوتي والمؤثرات الصوتية المبررة (SFX) أو الصمت المقصود فقط.

narrative_archetypes.visual_grammar: Paper texture background, ripped newspaper cutouts, bold highlighter sweeps, dashed callouts, and spring-snapped archival cards.
narrative_archetypes.audio_direction: Crisp paper rustle and marker-sweep SFX paired with documentary voiceover; zero background music.

narrative_archetypes.visual_grammar: Structured chapter progress bar, clean modular diagram cards, animated connector arrows, and camera focus shifts between concepts.
narrative_archetypes.audio_direction: Subtle UI click and chapter whoosh SFX paired with clear explanatory narration; zero background music.

narrative_archetypes.arabic_name: الرسم اليدوي بالحبر خطوة بخطوة (Hand-Drawn Explainer)
narrative_archetypes.visual_grammar: Warm paper canvas, progressive SVG stroke-dashoffset ink drawing, hand-sketched underlines, and concise Arabic annotations.
narrative_archetypes.audio_direction: Gentle pen-on-paper scratch SFX synchronized with line reveals; zero background music.

narrative_archetypes.visual_grammar: Real app or website screenshots placed inside clean 2.5D Fake-3D device frames, cursor-guided camera zooms, and crisp feature callout pills.
narrative_archetypes.audio_direction: Clean mechanical click and soft interface pop SFX; zero background music.

narrative_archetypes.visual_grammar: One persistent vector subject or camera path traveling continuously through maps, timelines, and live counters without hard slide resets.
narrative_archetypes.audio_direction: Motivated movement whooshes and counter tick SFX; zero background music.

narrative_archetypes.visual_grammar: Deep obsidian canvas, verified source-tagged evidence cards, glowing amber/red highlights, and precision camera push-ins.
narrative_archetypes.audio_direction: Low ambient room tone and crisp card-lock SFX; zero background music.

narrative_archetypes.visual_grammar: Soft watercolor wash transitions, organic brush-edge reveals, calm breathing camera drift, and clean gold/cream typography.
narrative_archetypes.audio_direction: Natural wind/ambience SFX and unhurried contemplative narration; zero background music.

narrative_archetypes.visual_grammar: 2D illustrated or Stickman characters placed across multi-plane 2.5D Fake-3D parallax stage layers; zero photorealistic 3D humans.
narrative_archetypes.audio_direction: Expressive cartoon/foley SFX and crisp cuts; zero background music.
